name: 60637 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60637 (Chicago) has 292 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 98 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60637 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60637 (Chicago) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 98 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
